podcast.body: Bauhaus covered this David Bowie song, which David Bowie himself "loved what Bajaus had done with." This cover contributed to Bowie's admiration for the band and their subsequent role in his film "The Hunger." "Bowie just loved what Bajaus had done with one of his old songs. That cover of Ziggy Startost..."
